title: Metal binding and oligomerization properties of FurC (PerR) from Anabaena sp. PCC7120: an additional layer of regulation?
authors: Sarasa-Buisan, Cristina; Emonot, Etienne; Martinez-Julvez, Marta; Sevilla, Emma; Velazquez-Campoy, Adrian; Crouzy, Serge; Bes, M Teresa; Michaud-Soret, Isabelle; Fillat, Maria F
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蓝藻FurC(PerR)转录因子的金属结合与寡聚化调控及其对DNA结合的氧化还原响应，虽涉及TF-DNA互作和AlphaFold结构建模，但核心为生化表征而非AI/物理模拟方法驱动的互作机制研究。
abstract: Metal and redox homeostasis in cyanobacteria is tightly controlled to preserve the photosynthetic machinery from mismetallation and minimize cell damage. This control is mainly taken by FUR (ferric uptake regulation) proteins. FurC works as the PerR (peroxide response) paralog in Anabaena sp. PCC7120. Despite its importance, this regulator remained poorly characterized. Although FurC lacks the typical CXXC motifs present in FUR proteins, it contains a tightly bound zinc per subunit. FurC: Zn stoichiometrically binds zinc and manganese in a second site, manganese being more efficient in the binding of FurC: Zn to its DNA target PprxA. Oligomerization analyses of FurC: Zn evidence the occurrence of different aggregates ranging from dimers to octamers. Notably, intermolecular disulfide bonds are not involved in FurC: Zn dimerization, dimer being the most reduced form of the protein. Oligomerization of dimers occurs upon oxidation of thiols by H2O2 or diamide and can be reversed by 1,4-Dithiothreitol (DTT). Irreversible inactivation of the regulator occurs by metal catalyzed oxidation promoted by ferrous iron. However, inactivation upon oxidation with H2O2 in the absence of iron was reverted by addition of DTT. Comparison of models for FurC: Zn dimers and tetramers obtained using AlphaFold Colab and SWISS-MODEL allowed to infer the residues forming both metal-binding sites and to propose the involvement of Cys86 in reversible tetramer formation. Our results decipher the existence of two levels of inactivation of FurC: Zn of Anabaena sp. PCC7120, a reversible one through disulfide-formed FurC: Zn tetramers and the irreversible metal catalyzed oxidation. This additional reversible regulation may be specific of cyanobacteria.
abstract_zh: 蓝细菌中金属和氧化还原稳态受到严格控制，以保护光合机制免受错误金属化并最小化细胞损伤。这种控制主要由FUR（铁摄取调节）蛋白承担。在鱼腥藻（Anabaena sp. PCC7120）中，FurC作为PerR（过氧化物响应）旁系同源物发挥作用。尽管其重要性，该调节因子仍未被充分表征。虽然FurC缺乏FUR蛋白中典型的CXXC基序，但每个亚基含有一个紧密结合的锌。FurC: Zn在第二个位点按化学计量结合锌和锰，其中锰在FurC: Zn与其DNA靶标PprxA结合时更为高效。FurC: Zn的寡聚化分析表明存在从二聚体到八聚体的不同聚集体。值得注意的是，分子间二硫键不参与FurC: Zn的二聚化，二聚体是蛋白质最还原的形式。二聚体的寡聚化发生在H2O2或二酰胺氧化硫醇后，并可通过1,4-二硫苏糖醇（DTT）逆转。调节因子的不可逆失活由亚铁离子促进的金属催化氧化引起。然而，在无铁条件下用H2O2氧化后的失活可通过添加DTT逆转。使用AlphaFold Colab和SWISS-MODEL获得的FurC: Zn二聚体和四聚体模型比较，推断出形成两个金属结合位点的残基，并提出Cys86参与可逆四聚体形成。我们的结果揭示了鱼腥藻（Anabaena sp. PCC7120）FurC: Zn存在两种失活水平：一种是通过二硫键形成的FurC: Zn四聚体实现的可逆失活，另一种是不可逆的金属催化氧化。这种额外的可逆调节可能为蓝细菌所特有。
